component.name: SuitestLibrary
component.script:
sub init() m.top.observeField("create_object", "create_object")
m.top.observeField("loadStatus", "OnSuitestLibStatusChanged") m.top.setField("uri", "http://the.suite.st/app/roku.zip") end sub
sub OnSuitestLibStatusChanged(event as object) if event.getData() = "ready" Suitest = CreateObject("roSGNode", "SuitestInstrumentationLib:main") Suitest.SetField("app_id", m.top.app_id) end if end sub
sub create_object(evt as object) data = evt.getData() obj = createObject("roSGNode", data.name)
data.properties.opacity = 0
obj.setFields(data.properties)
m.top.get_object = obj end sub
